source_standard: Spectral ruleset (OpenAPI linting) + OpenAPI schema conformance, https://stoplight.io/open-source/spectral

reference_resolution.rule: spectral_ruleset_id must resolve to an actual rule in the project's Spectral ruleset file — no orphan references (issue-515 invariant 2).

recomputation.rule: verdict is recomputed by re-running the spectral ruleset against the current endpoint_path, never a standalone asserted field (issue-515 invariant 4).
recomputation.checked_by: TBD (follow-up — issue-521 out-of-scope note: per-role recomputation enforcement is a follow-up once evidence from real usage shows which roles need it)

use_when.board_condition: an OpenAPI spec file changed on the branch AND no api-design record exists yet for that commit sha
